The '''fleet lizard''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of lizard that lived in the swamps of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]]. Fleet lizards had rib membranes that stretched beneath their [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and when escaping from danger, they would run on their hind legs and spread their membranes, in an attempt to sail away. At some point, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco|Parella]] journeyed to Lowick on a quest to locate the [[Unidentified Gorach artist|last member]] of the [[Gorach]] species, and he had his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] drones bomb the world's swamps, in an attempt to drive out the creature. A number of fleet lizards subsequently fled from the [[Fire/Legends|flames]] that were ignited by the bombing.<ref name="Insider133" />
